measurement: powermetrics estimated CPU+GPU+ANE power integrated over the sampled window
answer_quality_note: Natural completion was verified; answer correctness was not scored.
category_aggregation: Equal weight per prompt: average Qwen repetitions per prompt first, then average the three prompts in each category.
sampling_note: 20 ms samples requested for both systems because ten PromptCarbon analyses produce short blocks. Blocks with fewer than ten samples or invalid coverage are rejected.
limitations: 9 prompts are a small case study.
Different functions: analysis versus response generation.
The comparison is not an automatic saving when both systems are subsequently used.
Operational carbon uses fixed reference intensity 200 gCO2/kWh; it is not measured carbon.
